DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma with Malignant Pleural Effusion

The CA-125 is normal, which is atypical for advanced ovarian cancer, but the large right ovarian mass combined with a right-sided pleural effusion strongly suggests malignancy with metastatic spread. The normal white blood cell count and lack of fever make pyelonephritis highly unlikely.
